description: The engine's classes and those the project's scripts declare. info reads engine classes only, and script_info structure reads a project class. Headless, it updates .godot's class list and starts autoloads. Operations: query: classes matching a filter or category; info (needs className): methods, properties, signals and enums of one class, or one member of it by name; inheritance (needs className): ancestors and descendants of one class. Default query.

category.description: Limit to one family. For op query.

className.description: The class. Not for op query.

filter.description: A substring of the class name. For op query.

includeInherited.description: Also name every member the class inherits, under inherited. For op info.

instantiableOnly.description: Leave out abstract classes. Default false. For op query.

member.description: One member by name, with its signature and the class that declares it. Cheaper than a whole class. For op info.

name: editor_classes
title: Engine classes
